goal: The harness and the edge are wired up: requests go through nginx to a server-api replica, the correlation id survives the round trip, internal endpoints stay hidden. Runs against today's build (Spec01/Spec02 only).
_doc: Input requests. Locust loads this file, binds {{tokens}}, sends each request, then checks it against expectedFile.

cases.goal: Ping answers through the load balancer, and the response says which replica served it (Spec02 LB-10).
The client's X-Request-Id is kept end to end (nginx → API MDC → response), so a slow request in the report can be found in the logs.
Health summary is reachable through the edge and every dependency is UP (DB + Redis in readiness).
Other actuator endpoints are NOT exposed at the edge (no env / heap dump leaks under load).
An unknown API path is a ProblemDetail 404 from the API, not an nginx HTML page or a 5xx.
